outlet: Walla Walla Union-Bulletin, "Columbia County district asks for levy to support swimming pool in Dayton" (Simmerdeep Kaur, 2026-10-06)
notes: The $200,000 levy, about 20 cents per $1,000 (roughly $60 a year on a $300,000 home), in addition to current property taxes; district has secured $266,860 in grants and fundraising for construction and administration; no statement against.
